text: Given a group that is role-assignable in Graph (isAssignableToRole: true), When graph_list_groups lists it (e.g. "test two" on INT tenant 2qmxyw), Then that group's entry has isAssignableToRole: true and the Graph $select sent by the tool includes isAssignableToRole.

Given ordinary groups where Graph returns isAssignableToRole as false and as null, When graph_list_groups lists them, Then each entry keeps that exact value unchanged (null is never converted to false).

Given groups with onPremisesSyncEnabled true, false and null, When graph_list_groups lists them, Then sync_source is "on-premises" only when onPremisesSyncEnabled is truthy, else "cloud" -- the same rule graph_get_group uses -- and onPremisesSyncEnabled is present in the Graph $select.
Given the existing pagination contract (has_more/next_page_token/$skiptoken) and filtering (display_name/exact), When this fix is applied, Then the existing tests for both keep passing unmodified.

Given the same group on both connectors, When graph_list_groups on this single-tenant connector (INT tenant 2qmxyw, group "test two") is compared to the GDAP connector's graph_list_groups for the same group, Then isAssignableToRole, onPremisesSyncEnabled and sync_source match.
steps: On INT tenant 2qmxyw, call this connector's graph_list_groups with display_name="test two", exact=true
Record isAssignableToRole, onPremisesSyncEnabled, sync_source from the result
Call the GDAP connector's graph_list_groups for the same tenant/group
Compare the three fields between both results
expect: isAssignableToRole, onPremisesSyncEnabled and sync_source are identical between the two connectors for the same group
evidence: needs a live INT tenant (2qmxyw) and both connectors deployed; not executable from the design leg's sandbox (no network to live services). Dev leg should run this during self-test if INT access is available; otherwise report as not-run, not as passed.

text: Given graph_list_groups's tool description (as read via tools/list), When compared to graph_get_group's description, Then it documents isAssignableToRole with matching "null means an ordinary group" wording.
